overview: Add per-matter chat that streams assistant responses and shows locked, clickable sources per assistant message, preserving the evidence-first trust posture.
goals: Enable a chat panel in the Matter detail view where users can send messages and receive streaming assistant replies.
Support multiple threads per matter (thread list + titles) so chats can be separated by topic.
Persist chat threads and messages, including correct streaming/complete terminal states.
Lock sources (citations) per assistant message and render them under the assistant bubble.
Provide an evidence viewer page for chat citations without conflicting with the existing /citations/:id API route.
Preserve evidence-first behavior: if evidence is insufficient, respond exactly 'Not found in provided documents.' and show no sources.
nonGoals: Inline citations inside generated text (sources are rendered separately in v0).
Reranking models or advanced retrieval eval harnesses.
successMetrics: A user can send a message and see first tokens streamed in under 2 seconds on a dev laptop (best-effort target).
Assistant messages include at least one locked source when retrieval finds evidence; sources are clickable to an evidence viewer.
When retrieval finds no evidence, the assistant returns exactly 'Not found in provided documents.' and sources are empty.
API failures are explicit and safe: standard error envelope only, no stack traces or provider payloads returned.

stack.hosting: Local dev today; target deployments vary. Chat should be feature-flagged so enablement can be controlled per environment.
stack.auth: PoC: no end-user auth; some endpoints are admin-token gated and spike endpoints require SPIKES_ENABLED=1.

routes.name: Matter Detail
routes.purpose: Hosts the chat panel UI for a specific folder/matter.

routes.name: Chat Message API
routes.purpose: Accept a user message (including thread_id) and stream an assistant response for a matter.

routes.name: Citation API (Existing, Extended)
routes.purpose: Return locked citation payload for a citation id (used for both report rows and chat).

routes.name: Evidence Viewer
routes.purpose: PDF viewer page that loads a chat citation and highlights the cited page (coarse v0 polygon).

uiNotes: Chat panel includes a thread list (titles) with a simple create-new-thread action; thread titles are derived from the first user message in v0.
Sources render under assistant messages as chips (doc id + page number).
v0 highlight polygons are coarse full-page boxes; UI labels as page-level until OCR geometry exists.
Chat is embedded as a panel in the Matter detail page (server-first; keep client islands small).

fields: constraint: exactly one of report_row_id or chat_message_id is set

promptRules: Answer using only the provided sources.
If not supported by sources, respond exactly with the missingEvidenceExactString.

citationGeometry.note: Until OCR/layout geometry lands, citations use a coarse full-page polygon and UI labels it as page-level highlight.

constraints: Workflow entrypoint uses 'use workflow' and does not perform side effects directly.
Steps use 'use step' and own DB writes, retrieval, and model calls.
Streams are writable inside steps only.

steps.purpose: Fetch last N messages (e.g., N=20) from chat_messages for the selected thread to use as prompt context.
Call hybridSearch() (slice 0011a) for the latest user message query.
Fetch chunk text + doc/page metadata for top K hits to use as sources.
Call the model and stream tokens to the client via the WDK stream.
Persist citations for the assistant message in the unified citations table, including snippet_hash and polygons_json.
Mark assistant chat_messages.status='complete' (or a terminal failure status).

wdkWorkflow.idempotency: Each step has a deterministic step_key to prevent duplicate writes on retries.

featureFlags: CHAT_ENABLED (or equivalent): when disabled, the chat panel is hidden and /folders/:id/chat returns 404/disabled response.
Enable chat only in ORBITAL_MODE=dev or ORBITAL_MODE=demo-prod; default locked down when ORBITAL_MODE is unset or prod.
Optional: enable chat in dev first; do not require completing the broader dev-only route migration unless explicitly required for demo/prod.
rules: Evidence-first: assistant answers must be grounded in retrieved chunks; if not supported, respond exactly 'Not found in provided documents.'.
Locked sources are immutable: once an assistant message is complete, its citations do not change silently.
Evidence viewer must not conflict with existing /citations/:id API route; use /evidence/:id (or similar) for the page.
Chat feature is flaggable and allowlisted by runtime mode so it can ship dev-first and be promoted to demo-prod without forcing completion of broader 'dev-only route migration' work.

stories.title: Send a message and stream an assistant reply
stories.description: As a user, I want to send a chat message in a Matter and receive a streaming reply so that I can explore the documents quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: On /matters/:id, the chat panel shows a thread list (titles) and the selected thread's message history + input; creating a new thread and submitting 'What is the closing date?' starts streaming an assistant reply without a page refresh.

Example: A user message is persisted immediately; an assistant message is created with status='streaming' and transitions to status='complete' when finished; refreshing the page shows the same thread list and message history.
Negative: If the request body is missing or message is empty/invalid, POST /folders/:id/chat returns 400 with the standard safe error envelope.

stories.title: Locked sources render and open an evidence viewer
stories.description: As a user, I want clickable sources under assistant messages that open an evidence viewer so that I can verify the answer.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: After an assistant reply completes, the UI renders a 'Sources' section with one or more chips (document_id + page_number).

Example: Clicking a source navigates to /evidence/:id which loads citation payload from GET /citations/:id and then loads render_url via GET /documents/:id/render?page=N; a highlight overlay renders using polygons_json (v0 full-page box).
Negative: If the citation id is not found, GET /citations/:id returns 404 with a safe error envelope and /evidence/:id shows an explicit not-found state (no blank screen).

stories.title: Evidence-first behavior and safe failures
stories.description: As a user, I want the assistant to be honest about missing evidence and for failures to be explicit so that the system remains trustworthy.
acceptanceCriteria: Example: When retrieval returns no chunks, the assistant response is exactly 'Not found in provided documents.' and the Sources section is empty.
Example: If the model call fails mid-stream, the assistant message transitions to a terminal failure status (e.g., 'citation_failed') and the UI shows an explicit error state with guidance to retry.
Negative: When chat is disabled via feature flag, /folders/:id/chat returns 404/disabled response and the UI hides the chat panel.
